quest.title: Rumors Abound
quest.description: Peace talks between Watatsumi Island and the Tenryou Commission are due to commence, but a rumor that the Tenryou Commission remains in cahoots with the Fatui is still circulating around the island. To uncover the truth, Kokomi decides to assault the Fatui's temporary encampment...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x550, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: Warriors' Dreams Like Spring Grass Renewing

talks.objective: Go to the temporary Fatui camp

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: This must be the Fatui camp that the merchant was talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: From the looks of it, it used to be a hilichurl camp. Who knows why the Fatui occupied it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... looks pretty heavily guarded, how are we supposed to get in?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Not by brute force, that's for sure. But that's not a problem. The terrain here gives us an advantage, and we haven't given away our position so far.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Our enemy is in the light, while we are in the shadows. Strategically, we have the upper hand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what does the grand strategist have in mind?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think we have three options available.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Option 1: Take the king and it's checkmate. The Fatui's presence in Inazuma is weak at present. Nothing more than a few scattered remnants.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: If we strike from above and take down their leader first, the rest of them will be hard-pressed to put up a serious fight.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #Option 2: Hit them where it hurts. Over there, {NICKNAME}, for example — a store of gunpowder kegs.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: If we managed to discreetly set the gunpowder alight without alerting them, it would deal them a devastating blow.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: They'd be caught completely off guard. Both their morale and fighting capacity would be severely impaired.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Option 3: Use the environment against them. We're close to the sea here, so the air is very humid. I can gather the water vapor, you add a touch of lightning, and together we can shock them into submission.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's our grand strategist! It's a lot to think about though... which option should we choose?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: That will depend on our assessment of our own abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: A surprise attack from the air is the quickest solution, but requires superior combat skills.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: With an explosion, we could rapidly reduce their numbers without a protracted battle. But absolute stealth would be required during the operation, or we'd risk exposing ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #If we decide to take advantage of the environment, we should be prepared for a lengthy siege. So, {NICKNAME}, which is your preferred option?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Haha... There's the Swordfish captain I know. Every confidence in your abilities.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It's decided then — let's fight this one together. I'm no warrior myself, but I can still provide some support. I certainly won't be dropping you into battle all by yourself.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: We should take them down as quickly as possible and retrieve the merchant's goods.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Haha, it seems that you share my strategic sensibilities.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: This is my preferred tactic. It places us in the least amount of danger.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Let's work together to give them the surprise of their lives.

choices.text: Let's spark things up a little.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Alright. We'll draw them out first to minimize damage to the camp itself.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I haven't had much chance to fight alongside you in the past, I'm not sure I'll be able to keep up with your pace...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Still, not to worry. Even if I can't claim to be a warrior myself, I'm no stranger to the battlefield. This fight should be well within my capabilities.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Okay. Let's clear out the camp and find out what they've been up to.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kokomi~!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kokomi, we found the merchant's stuff. Look!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Mm... I see.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Oh, nothing. I just zoned out for a moment.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Let's see here... Yes, these are the stolen goods alright.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Food, medicine, farming tools... All essential for post-war recovery. He was probably stockpiling them until he could make a handsome profit.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: By contrast, it's doubtful that the Tenryou Commission has any need of these items, so the idea that he was supplying them doesn't make a lot of sense.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: In all likelihood, he's just an opportunistic merchant. Nothing quite as scandalous as Matsuda and Uchimura had imagined.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... he's hardly a saint, though, right? How could he stockpile things that people are desperate for?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're not gonna just give them back to him and let him go, are we? It doesn't feel right...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Don't worry, I had already foreseen this.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: In my recently issued Post-War Temporary Decree, I included restrictions on the prices of essential everyday goods. These items will ultimately reach the people at a reasonable price.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: If he had taken the time to read the decree, it's unlikely he ever would have ended up in this predicament.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kokomi, you think of everything!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I wish that were true. Take this alleged collusion between the Tenryou Commission and the Fatui, for example. I'm still completely stumped.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The low energy doesn't exactly help...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Huh? What do you mean by that?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Nothing. Come on, let's take the goods back.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It's not long now until the Victory Feast. It'll be a race against the clock to get all of this resolved before it starts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it! First we mend the peace, then we attend the feast!

talks.objective: Defeat the Fatui in the camp
Defeat the Fatui in the camp

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #Excellent work, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, all thanks to your genius tactics!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Actually, even the best tactics live or die on the strength of those executing them.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Winning a battle takes a concerted effort from everyone involved. Victory never belongs to a single person.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, Paimon did make a pretty big contribution, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I beg to differ.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I must admit, I wasn't expecting to find the Fatui laying low in a hilichurl camp. Presumably they've been operating out of here in secret for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: What's their objective? Are the soldiers right? Could they really be in collusion with the Tenryou Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Let's scour the camp for evidence. If the merchant's story is true, the inventory should be here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Time to take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hmm... That wasn't quite what I'd call "by the book"...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: But it happens. Battles are complex things and the situation evolves constantly. It doesn't always help to stick too rigidly to a predetermined plan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Seems like as soon as the fighting started, the plan went out the window and we kinda winged it...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: And yet, the outcome is quite satisfactory. A testament to your ability and willingness to adapt.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I must admit, I wasn't expecting to find the Fatui laying low in a hilichurl camp. Presumably they've been operating out of here in secret for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: What's their objective? Are the soldiers right? Could they really be in collusion with the Tenryou Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Let's scour the camp for evidence. If the merchant's story is true, the inventory should be here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Time to take a look around.

talks.objective: Give the cargo back to the merchants

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: My goods! You got 'em back!

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: Thank you, Your Excellency! And thank you, Captain!

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: You see? I told you I was innocent!

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: Hmph... I'm not so sure. You could have easily planned the whole thing with the Fatui in advance...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Based on the information we gathered from the Fatui camp, there's nothing to suggest he had any correspondence with them.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Had it been the case, then knowing how the Fatui operates, they would have left some evidence of it.

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: But... what if—

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: No ifs, no buts. We've recovered the goods. As agreed, this is sufficient to establish his innocence.

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: Sorry this happened.

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: Guess we got carried away.

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: Hah! What did I tell you? You army numskulls don't have a clue — all brawn and no brains! Coming to me with your crazy conspiracies... Lay off me next time, got it?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Sir, I'm afraid you're getting ahead of yourself. You may be innocent of the accusations originally leveled at you, but hoarding essential goods is a crime under the Temporary Decree. You must bear the consequences.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: You have already admitted to being the owner of these goods, so we are obliged to respond with appropriate measures. In addition to enforcing the sale of these goods at the accepted rates, there will also be a fine, the amount of which—

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: Wait, wait, wait! Your Excellency... Whose side are you on here?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I have no business taking sides. As the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island, I abide by the principle of clear and consistent rewards and punishments.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Just as merit must be recognized, mistakes must be penalized. You may have been proven innocent of the more serious allegations leveled at you, but this does not exempt you from bearing the consequences of your mistakes.

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: Wait a minute! I... But...

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: Well, don't just stand there — take him away! Time to pay up!

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: Your Excellency, he says all the goods belong to him, but it doesn't add up.

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: Those with a Tenryou Commission emblem are probably his, but not the rest. Especially these ones — they're clearly for shrine use.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Mm... It seems the Fatui simply dumped all their stolen goods in one place. Leave the shrine paraphernalia to me. As for the rest, I'll leave you to sift through and try to track down the owners.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I know that's a lot to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: Not at all, Your Excellency, we're on it.

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: But if I may, Your Excellency... Maybe there were no signs of collusion in this case, but our people know what they saw. Something is going on between the Tenryou Commission and the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: I know the peace talks are coming up, so... please keep an open mind.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I understand your concern. I'll be sure to give it further consideration.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, I'm going to take these items back to the Sangonomiya Shrine. Why don't you come along for the walk?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: You know, the earliest shrine on Watatsumi Island was not located in Sangonomiya.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: It was close to the Statue of The Seven. Back then, the people of this island recognized the Shogun's existence, despite not venerating her as the Shogunate do.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: But after she struck down our protector deity, the shrine was abandoned.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Relations between Watatsumi Island and the Shogunate have soured ever since. Mistrust has become deep-rooted over time.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I've been hoping to raise all this at the peace talks and discuss it properly. Grievances have to be let go eventually...

dialogues.speaker: Youkou
dialogues.text: Your Excellency, what brings you out this way on your busy schedule?

dialogues.speaker: Youkou
dialogues.text: Oh my, you're looking a little worse for wear... You need to take better care of yourself, okay? All of our fates depend on you...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Mm, thanks for your concern, but I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Yuna
dialogues.text: Your Excellency, I beg you, heed a word of advice. After all this time fighting the Shogun's Army, peace is not something that can simply be declared.

dialogues.speaker: Yuna
dialogues.text: If we reconcile with them, the god who once protected us will have died in vain...

dialogues.speaker: Youkou
dialogues.text: Come on, that's ancient history. Besides, the fighting is barely over. We should be grateful to be at peace once more.

dialogues.speaker: Yuna
dialogues.text: I know, I know, it's just... *sigh* We should remain strong in these negotiations. We mustn't be too ready to compromise.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I appreciate your concerns. I will consider the options carefully and be sure to proceed appropriately.

dialogues.speaker: Yuna
dialogues.text: Wonderful... We're all counting on you, Your Excellency.

dialogues.speaker: Shiori
dialogues.text: Your Excellency? Well, I'll be! Fancy meeting you at a place like this.

dialogues.speaker: Shiori
dialogues.text: Do you know — my daughter's enrolled herself in the shrine maiden selection process this year. If she makes it into Sangonomiya, I'll be one very happy mother! You're a kind and gracious leader. She'd be in very good hands.

dialogues.speaker: Shiori
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm always telling my daughter that if she gets the chance to learn from Her Excellency directly, she must make the most of it.

dialogues.speaker: Shiori
dialogues.text: I mean, just look at Her Excellency. Still so young, but so mature and intelligent. My daughter has always looked to you as a role model.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Well, if she comes to Sangonomiya, I'll look out for her...

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Ah, Your Excellency! Boy, am I glad you're here. As you know, agricultural output has taken a pretty big hit this year, let me bring you up to speed on the latest situation...

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: #Oh, Your Excellency, isn't this the captain of Swordfish II? Will {F#she}{M#he} be based on Watatsumi Island from now on?

dialogues.speaker: Yukiya
dialogues.text: Your Excellency...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Uh... Please remain calm, everyone, I'll get around to all your queries.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Though for the longer ones, I'd prefer it if you could write a report and submit it to the shrine. Then I can respond to each one as and when I have the time.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, are you alright?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Heh... This kind of thing is water off a duck's back for you, huh?

response.speaker: Izumi Naki
response.text: Your Excellency, here you are.

response.speaker: Izumi Naki
response.text: There's been a situation. We're still waiting on the delivery of a whole batch of ceremonial items. I'm beginning to worry that they've been stolen...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Oh, we retrieved those already — no need to worry.

response.speaker: Izumi Naki
response.text: Really? That's fantastic! You never cease to amaze us, Your Excellency!

response.speaker: Izumi Naki
response.text: I sorted through all the petitions received recently and placed them on your desk.

response.speaker: Izumi Naki
response.text: Also, according to the schedule, you're just in time for your meeting today on the development of the textiles industry...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: That's today? ...Right now?

response.speaker: Izumi Naki
response.text: Yes. The two young ladies have arrived safely, we're just waiting for you.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: #Mm, I see... *sigh* {NICKNAME}, I was hoping to take a walk around the island with you, but it looks like we'll have to save that for some other time.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Let's rendezvous tomorrow at the entrance to Sangonomiya Shrine. Then we'll go and make preparations for the Victory Feast.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay, the Victory Feast! Just to be clear, we're talking lots of delicious food, right?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Haha... That's the name of the game. There'll be some Watatsumi Island specialties which I'm sure you'll enjoy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! See you tomorrow then!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Mm...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: *sigh* Me too. It does get pretty annoying...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I must admit, I wasn't expecting to find the Fatui laying low in a hilichurl camp. Presumably they've been operating out of here in secret for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: What's their objective? Are the soldiers right? Could they really be in collusion with the Tenryou Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Let's scour the camp for evidence. If the merchant's story is true, the inventory should be here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Time to take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: Don't get cocky!

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: It's no use looking for an escape route!

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: Just you wait until Her Excellency finishes her investigation...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: The king is overthrown, only the pawns remain!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: The explosion was roughly the size I expected. Hopefully, we've given them a fright.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Their movements have become rigid and sluggish. We make a good team!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Watatsumi Island observes different customs than the rest of Inazuma. I imagine it must all seem a little alien to you?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: It's been a long time since I last came to this village. There's been a lot to deal with recently...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Next time you visit, I'll take you to visit Watatsumi Island's old shrine.
